A single question reduces the set of 1000 possibilities to a minimum group size of 75. To distinguish all possibilities with only 2 questions, the second question would need to partition every group from the first question perfectly into singletons. Our greedy search for a second question on the largest group (75 elements) failed to reduce the max group size to 1, reaching only 2. This strongly suggests 2 questions are insufficient.
